description.en: Sets the state of the current objective (purpose) display: the value (any non-zero value counts as 1) is written into the two objective display objects. PurposeEffect switches it on and off every 20 frames to make the new objective blink.
true (or non-zero) to show the objective, false to hide it.
Always null (also when the script system is not ready or no argument is given, in which case nothing changes).

examples.case: After loading a new objective (real usage, from ev42061300.nut)
